Game Overview

In Gold Coast, the core idea is straightforward: embark on a thrilling treasure hunt in Gold Coast, where every gem, bag, and nugget boosts your score. Dodge explosive barrels and upgrade your mining prowess. With captivating music and stunning visuals, each level offers increased challenges and excitement in your quest for riches.
